title: Civilization VI menu
description: The Civilization VI interface has been brought into Minecraft.
body:
This resource pack redesigns the Minecraft main menu with the aesthetic of Civilization VI: Gathering Storm, and sets its theme song, Sogno di Volare, as the background music.This pack is currently in beta. 
将《Minecraft》的主菜单界面，替换为《文明VI：风云变幻》的风格，并融入了其主题曲《Sogno di Volare》作为背景音乐。这个资源包还在测试阶段，功能不全
